sources.excerpt: The Men's time trial of the 2026 UCI Road World Championships was a cycling event that took place on 20 September 2026 in Montreal, Canada.

In cycling, Belgian rider Remco Evenepoel becomes the first man to win four consecutive Road World Championship titles in the individual time trial event and equals Fabian Cancellara and Tony Martin's joint record for the most titles.

In American football, the artificial turf at Nissan Stadium in Nashville, Tennessee, U.S., reportedly reaches 157 °F (69 °C) amidst extreme heat during the Tennessee Titans matchup against the Philadelphia Eagles. Air temperatures were approximately 95 °F (35 °C) at the time of the game.

Singapore's Land Transport Authority introduces fines of up to S$500 (US$390) for eating on public buses or placing feet on seats, while severe cleanliness or safety violations can incur penalties of up to S$5,000 (US$3,900).
The fragment was hidden among a collection of early Christian manuscripts from Egypt, stored within the library of Utrecht University.

Within these Greek texts, Mark de Kreij, an expert in Greek language and literature at nearby Radboud University, found a “damaged and discolored fragment with very small, neat letters,” per the statement. He recognized it as an excerpt from The Odyssey—specifically, Book 12.
Portions of The Odyssey that are this old are rare: Only about 30 pieces have been found that date to the third or fourth century.
